description: This file is a shell script used for testing remote helper commands in a Git project. It sets up repositories, performs clone, fetch, push, and other Git operations to verify remote helper functionality, including support for signed tags, ref updates, and failure conditions.

methods.name: compare_refs
methods.description: Compares the revision hashes of two refs or commits in separate Git directories, with optional failure indicator.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a test case expecting success with specific commands.

methods.name: test_must_fail
methods.description: Defines a test case expecting the command to fail.

methods.name: test_expect_code
methods.description: Checks for specific exit code from commands.

methods.name: clean_mark
methods.description: Cleans and compares the object markings in Git object database.
